source: NpcTemplate.calculateDrops(DropType.DROP, victim, killer) (calculateGroupDrops, calculateUngroupedDrops, calculateGroupDrop, calculateUngroupedDrop)
note: Raid bosses and grand bosses with the shipped Rates.ini (the victim is a raid: DropMaxOccurrencesRaidboss and the raid multipliers). Every case has 'rnd': every Rnd call the real calculateDrops made, in order, one string per call: 'D<u>' is Rnd.nextDouble() returning u in [0,1); 'L<origin>,<bound>=<value>' is Rnd.get(long origin, long bound) returning the value (origin + floor(u*(bound-origin+1)); a call with origin >= bound draws nothing and is not recorded); any other call is '<method> <bound>=<value>' (none occurs in drops). 'script' names the scripted unit values (see drops_setup.json). Replay the returned values in order and check the kind and bounds. 'result' is the list of [item id, count] calculateDrops returned (an empty list is Java's null).
